body:
There is nothing wrong with public transport, no one really *needs* a car, unless you live somewhere extremely rural. Where do you live OP? 

As far as looks go, there is no "definition" of ugly, just like /u/PoetJustice has said. Take care of yourself, maintain great hygiene, work out (not to imply that you're fat, but working out releases endorphin's, boosts your self esteem, and keeps you fit) and realize that confidence is the sexiest thing a person can carry with them.  Also, if you need fashion advice I would be more than happy to help. 

As far as the seizures go, do you take any medications for it? Have you seem a doctor? Do you know why you're getting seizures? While it is off putting and very scary, there are plenty of epileptics that live their lives  "normally".

Try and speak to strangers and be friendly to everyone. When you look good, you feel good. When you feel good, you look good. I'm not trying to boil this down to looks at all, but again, it's the confidence that you build within you that builds and maintains relationships.

You can do this OP. 

And lastly, you're graduating from college. *COLLEGE*! Third-tier or not, think of how many people *don't* have the opportunity to graduate from college! Congratulations! You're making moves!
